items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1993-07-17
items.q: I mean, I did Dookie Chase's band, 17 pieces in that room.

ctx.x: Okay, real number two, Cosmo Mitassa, July 16th or 17th? Today's the 17th. Okay, so we're continuing. Okay, so you moved, so you had, you went from a four mixer to eight. To an eight. Okay, and what did that give you? What capacity? We could go back over that. Well, now that you had eight.

It allowed me, number one, to mic more things independently and get a little bit better balance that wasn't physical by placement of the people in the room, because that was always difficult. And if you had more than five players, it was really difficult. Did you often have more than five? Oh, sure. I mean, I did Dookie Chase's band, 17 pieces in that room.
